mapper.sql:
WITH role_identities AS (
SELECT CAST(COALESCE((SELECT TRIM(user_app_id) FROM wechat_config ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), '') AS BINARY) AS app_id, CAST(openid AS BINARY) AS open_id, id AS user_id, NULL AS merchant_identity_id, NULL AS rider_identity_id FROM user_profile UNION ALL SELECT CAST(app_id AS BINARY), CAST(open_id AS BINARY), NULL, id, NULL FROM merchant_identity UNION ALL SELECT CAST(app_id AS BINARY), CAST(openid AS BINARY), NULL, NULL, id FROM rider_identity ), accounts AS ( SELECT MAX(user_id) AS user_id, MAX(merchant_identity_id) AS merchant_identity_id, MAX(rider_identity_id) AS rider_identity_id FROM role_identities GROUP BY app_id, open_id )

FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN user_profile u ON u.id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN merchant_identity mi ON mi.id = a.merchant_identity_id LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.id = mi.merchant_id LEFT JOIN rider r ON r.id = a.rider_identity_id
a.user_id IS NOT NULL a.merchant_identity_id IS NOT NULL a.rider_identity_id IS NOT NULL
AND (LOCATE(#{keyword}, u.display_name) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword}, m.name) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword}, r.name) > 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT COALESCE(CONCAT('user:', a.user_id), CONCAT('merchant:', a.merchant_identity_id), CONCAT('rider:', a.rider_identity_id)) AS id, u.display_name AS nickname, m.name AS merchantName, CASE WHEN a.merchant_identity_id IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN m.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'REMOVED' ELSE COALESCE(m.audit_status, 'NOT_ENROLLED') END AS merchantStatus, r.name AS riderName, CASE WHEN a.rider_identity_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(r.audit_status, 'NOT_ENROLLED') END AS riderStatus
ORDER BY a.user_id DESC, a.merchant_identity_id DESC, a.rider_identity_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
